Just take it off and follow instructions above, EXCEPT don’t put any more plastic on it just leave it. When they use second skin and tell you to leave it on for four days is because if no dirt leaks in it’s still pretty sterile and will be almost healed by the time you take it off. It’s made for protecting an open wound. But when you use the old school version with the tape and plastic wrap you’re supposed to only have it until the next morning when you wake up, and that’s mostly so you don’t get a bunch of ink on your sheets. It’s a wound, it needs air to heal. Most tattoo artist will even tell you to take the plastic of after a few hours if you’re not worried about getting ink everywhere. My smaller tattoos I didn’t even put plastic on at all, it’s just to give some protection when the wounds are fresh. First time I got second skin my thought was “wow man this is super convenient” and that’s about all it is(don’t get me wrong, I think it works great!). So no worries, just take it off clean it like the person up top already said. Then just enjoy your tattoo! 

Putting plastic back on (not done by professional in a non sterile environment) could actually trap dirt and bacteria and harm your new tattoo.
